title: Localise Campaigns | Adding Store Segments

bodyMd:
After defining your localisation strategy, add store segments to Personalisation Hub and launch campaigns targeted at those segments to control which campaigns play in each store/location. Types of Store Segments: Fixed (controlled by and only visible to Headquarters); Variable (controlled by Retail Store Managers and Headquarters, visible to all staff). Step-by-Step: Login to HQ Admin > Company Settings > Store Segments > add desired Variable & Fixed Store Segments > Stores & Branches > select store(s) > add the Variable/Fixed store segments to each store > Save Changes. Add Targeting Rules: open the Campaign > Audience Targeting tab > [+ Add New 'AND' Condition] > select 'Store / Location Data' > select Variable/Fixed Store Segments > operator (e.g. 'includes selected') > add segments > Save Changes. NOTE: Use 'Store Segments (Consolidated)' to add segments that could be either fixed or variable.
